messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "store between 4°C and 30°C (39°F and 86°F)"
set: ["store between 4°C and 30°C (39°F and 86°F)", "store between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F)", "store in the refrigerator between 36°F and 46°F (2°C and 8°C)", "junction between nerves and muscle", "Difference between antidepressant and placebo", "store at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C) away from moisture and heat", "not interchangeable between liquid and tablets", "difference is between safe and dangerous doses", "kept from 8°C to 30°C (46°F to 86°F) for up to 28 days", "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "bottle sizes vary between products and pack sizes", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "difference between too little and too much is small", "store in refrigerator between 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC)", "store in refrigerator between 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F)", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
